comment: Reviewed read/write nature of third-party MCP tools, by server. The native CLI classifier reads DWS's own schema; an MCP server outside that schema needs its catalogue recorded here, so a run that only read cannot pass as a run that wrote. A tool missing from this file stays unjudged: it is never treated as evidence and never causes a refusal, so adding a tool to a server cannot break its tasks -- but it also will not be gated until it is listed.
